title: Choose the look of KANDO (bolder set)
question: A bolder set, all new. Pick one for the entry screens, Home, Search and the provider page, or ask for another set.

options.label: Das Straßenfest
options.lineage: a neighbourhood street party: bunting, painted banners, folding tables
options.thesis: Hilfe from next door is a party you are invited to: huge friendly type, bunting across the top, and every helper a bright flag.
options.viewport: A sun-yellow screen, a row of bunting flags across the top, a giant navy headline, helper flags in red and teal, and one huge red button.
options.risk: Loud colour and big type can tip into children's-party kitsch; forms, prices and payment must drop to a calm white surface.

options.label: Der Scherenschnitt
options.lineage: Matisse-style cut-paper shapes: leaves, houses, hands and suns in flat saturated colour
options.thesis: Every kind of help is a bold cut-paper shape, and the whole street is a collage of people you can trust.
options.viewport: A cream sheet, huge cut-paper leaf, house and sun shapes, a blue headline, and category shapes as big tappable cut-outs.
options.risk: Organic shapes behind text can reduce contrast; every text block needs a solid cut-paper plate.

options.label: Die Nachbarschaftskarte
options.lineage: a hand-painted illustrated neighbourhood map, like a local festival poster
options.thesis: Home is a bright illustrated map of your street, and every helper is a pin you can walk to.
options.viewport: A green and cream painted map with fat streets, little houses, three red helper pins with faces, and a bottom sheet listing who is near.
options.risk: A map competes with a list for the main screen; users who just want a price list must reach it in one tap.

options.label: Torn-paper collage
options.lineage: dada collage of tram tickets and newsprint
options.case: Loses both: a found-object layout makes money and ID screens hard to trust.
options.kept: Pasted-on paper labels for helper tags.

options.label: Treasure map
options.case: Loses both: false trails and coded marginalia are the opposite of a clear booking path.
options.kept: The map as the way to explore, taken into the neighbourhood map.

options.label: Glaze river shelf
options.case: Loses both: an elegant craft piece, but a warning-state spill looks like an error on a payment screen.
options.kept: One saturated blue as the single accent colour.
